parts.reading: V27 is an external vertical output transistor; printed factory type absent
parts.argument: Page 10 and manual page 14 identify the upper vertical output transistor role, but no printed factory type. The existing upper NPN candidate is provisionally a BD139-class device. Its handwritten BD140 annotation would imply PNP and conflicts with that stage interpretation; page-10 pin/arrow connectivity remains open. The ST BD139/BD140 data sheet supplies a 25–250 class hFE envelope, with BF=60 as the bounded candidate rather than a historical identity.
parts.typical_source: ST BD139/BD140 Rev 5, page 4, https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/bd139.pdf; hFE 40–250 at IC=150 mA and minimum 25 at IC=5 mA and 500 mA

parts.reading: V18 is the horizontal output NPN transistor; SU165 is a handwritten annotation, not a factory board-BOM type
parts.argument: Schematic page 4 and operating-manual page 19 place V18 as the transistor driving T3 at the 16 kHz line rate. No printed assembly type is identified. The ST BU508AF is an NPN CRT horizontal-deflection output device with a documented hFE range of 5–30 across its 0.1 A and 4.5 A test points; this bounds the existing BF=20 candidate without claiming it is the original V18. Switching time and safe operation remain A2 work.
parts.typical_source: ST BU508AF Rev 2, pages 1 and 4, https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/bu508af.pdf; hFE 10–30 at IC=0.1 A/VCE=5 V and minimum 5 at IC=4.5 A/VCE=5 V

parts.reading: V21 is the EHT rectifier; no factory part type is printed for the assembly diode
parts.argument: Schematic page 4 draws V21 from T3 X1:1 to X1:2/EHT, and operating-manual page 19 says V21 charges the tube to 11–12 kV. The board BOM does not identify this assembly diode. A 15 kV nominal, 12–16 kV bounded rectifier class is therefore used for electrical modelling, not asserted as the historical type. The T3 pin/return topology remains open in the page-4 netlist review.
parts.typical_source: VRRM in Rectron R12000H (12 kV), https://www.rectron.com/public/product_datasheets/r12000h.pdf, and Semtech SDH15K (15 kV), https://www.semtech.com/uploads/design-support/SG-SEMTECH-PD-DATABOOK.pdf, data-book pages 348–349; bounds are a candidate class, not an original part rating

parts.typical_source: older.pdf page 3 annotated R43 series topology; older-operation.pdf page 17 R41 temperature-compensation role; documented 012-6921:R13 470-ohm thermistor in the same bias chain (older.pdf page 7)
parts.argument: Both page-3 crops show an upper thermistor labelled R43 between R25 and R24, with no numeric value. Manual page 17 calls the temperature-compensation part R41, while the page-8 BOM skips R41. Model their correspondence as a provisional class-typical hypothesis, not a confirmed factory designator map. Use a fixed-temperature 470-ohm equivalent, bounded 100..2000 ohms, from same-chain documented R13. The isolated stage bench moves control/reactance by 3.4% and secondary by 11.7% at 100 ohms versus nominal, and control/reactance by about 11% at 2000 ohms; bounds stay exposed. The page-3 schematic connection review remains open.
